title: Japanese-Style Irish Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Irish stew infused with the rich flavors of Japan. A unique twist on a classic dish.

ingredients.name: Irish Stew Meat
ingredients.notes: Use either beef or lamb for best results

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the Irish stew meat in batches until browned on all sides. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then cook the sliced onions until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned meat back to the pot, along with the soy sauce and sake (if using).
Stir to combine, then add the cauliflower florets. Cover the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
